evidence.quote: Term sheet: class fund $48,000,000; attorneys' fees $10,000,000; clear sailing no; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
Our counteroffer is $25 million for the class and $6 million in fees, subject to court approval
we propose a $35 million class fund. We retain your $6 million fee figure

summary: Plaintiffs first included fee requests in their opening term sheets, and fee amounts were negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was settled. The transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff between fees and class recovery, self-interested plaintiff reasoning, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
